observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa dalawang card: (1) inilalarawan ang tiyak na resource concern nang factual; (2) tinutukoy ang polisiya, responsable at service/safety needs na dapat tiyakin; (3) ipinapaalam ang angkop na unang hakbang bago pagbabago, walang sariling cut, paglilipat o repair.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In both cards: (1) describes the specific resource concern factually; (2) identifies the policy, responsible person and service/safety needs to check; (3) communicates an appropriate first step before changes, without independent cuts, reallocation or repairs.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Kumikilos bago tiyakin ang requirements, nagtatabi ng supplies nang kusa, nag-iimbento ng savings o hindi matukoy ang contact at tuntunin.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Acts before checking requirements, sets supplies aside independently, invents savings or cannot identify the contact and rule.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapakita ang tatlong kilos sa dalawang card nang walang prompt at malinaw ang hangganan ng tungkulin.
levels.kaya_na_en: Demonstrates all three actions in both cards without prompts and explains role limits.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tamang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa factual na tala, requirements o pakikipag-ugnayan bago pagbabago.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Appropriate direction but needs prompts for the factual record, requirements or coordination before changes.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: May sariling pagbabago o unsupported cut, o hindi matukoy ang dapat tiyakin; itama at ulitin bago masabing kaya na.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Makes an independent change or unsupported cut, or cannot identify what to check; correct and repeat before rating proficient.
